title: Use the circumference
text: On this interval the circle is traced exactly once, so the length is the circumference $$2\pi R$$.

title: Plug in the radius
text: $$2\pi\times5=10\pi$$. You can confirm this with the arc length integral: $$r^2+{r'}^2=100$$, so $$L=\int_{0}**{\pi}10\,d\theta=10\pi$$
